# Celestial Night

Celestial Night is a radiant dark color scheme evoking late-night writing and intended to ease eye strain. It uses soft contrasts, muted highlights and subtle accents across the editor and the interface.

![Celestial Night screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluemoondragon07/Obsidian-Celestial-Night-Theme/HEAD/assets/low-res.png)
